style.vernacular: Dense Caspian-coast city of pale limestone: the walled Old City of narrow lanes, flat-roofed stone houses and caravanserais; Belle-Epoque oil-boom mansions and apartment blocks in cream and honey limestone with carved Baroque and Gothic ornament; Stalin-era limestone-clad monumental blocks; Soviet panel and brick estates in grey and ochre; and a modern skyline of white and glass towers. Mostly flat or low-pitched roofs, strong winds, little rain, sparse planting of pines, plane trees and mulberries.
style.ornament: Local Absheron limestone (cream to honey) dressed in carved Baroque and Moorish ornament on oil-boom facades; Shirvan-Absheron style pointed and ogee arches, stalactite (muqarnas) portals and ribbed domes; the buta (paisley/flame) motif in relief and railings; flame-shaped and fluid forms on modern landmarks.

sources.what: climate (cold semi-arid, windy), Old City walls/narrow alleys, eclectic early 20th-century landmarks, all-glass towers, parks
Old City, Soviet-era marble/granite-faced and limestone monuments, Flame Towers, flame motif
local Gulbaht limestone used in current mosque; Shirvan school
